cards.card_text: And they top it off: "Whereas my father scourged you with whips, I will scourge you with scorpions." I think those words would land hard on people already under a heavy yoke.
cards.verse_text: Whereas my father scourged you with whips, I will scourge you with scorpions.’”
cards.snippet: Whereas my father scourged you with whips, I will scourge you with scorpions.’”

cards.card_text: The king answers them harshly, rejecting the elders' advice and speaking as the young men advised: “Whereas my father scourged you with whips, I will scourge you with scorpions.” Whips to SCORPIONS.
cards.verse_text: Whereas my father scourged you with whips, I will scourge you with scorpions.”
cards.snippet: Whereas my father scourged you with whips, I will scourge you with scorpions.”

cards.card_text: Then David asks the LORD to remove His scourge from him, and says he's perishing by the force of His hand.
cards.verse_text: Remove Your scourge from me; I am perishing by the force of Your hand.
cards.snippet: Remove Your scourge from me; I am perishing by the force of Your hand.

cards.card_text: The scourge will not touch them Their kingdom will grow larger Their names will be remembered
cards.verse_text: When the overwhelming scourge passes through it will not touch us, because we have made lies our refuge and falsehood our hiding place.”
cards.snippet: When the overwhelming scourge passes through it will not touch us, because we have made lies…

cards.card_text: The rulers were sure the overwhelming scourge would pass them by.
cards.verse_text: When the overwhelming scourge passes through, you will be trampled by it.
cards.snippet: When the overwhelming scourge passes through, you will be trampled by it.
